rationale: Finance approval must precede payout. The user reports that Support loses track of ownership across the dashboard-to-email handoff and that retrying after a timeout can duplicate a request. The proposed flow preserves the approval decision, keeps one record and reference across retries, and identifies who acts next through payout. Its clearest verification scenario drops the response after the server saves the request, then checks that a reload and retry recover the entered details and leave Finance with exactly one request. The approval channel and provider retry capabilities remain explicit design questions. The execution events show only reads, the fixture snapshots match, and the response presents its checks as planned.
